title: stmf0xx.h comment contains non-utf-8 character
clean_text:
Title: stmf0xx.h comment contains non-utf-8 character

Body:
cmsis_device_f0/Include/stm32f0xx.h:60:  * - Product miscellaneous configuration: assert macros, �

clang-16 warns about invalid utf-8 characters in comments:
cmsis_device_f0/Include/stm32f0xx.h:60:59: warning: invalid UTF-8 in comment [-Winvalid-utf8]
[build]   * - Product miscellaneous configuration: assert macros, <85>

assuming a UTF-8 locale the following command can be used to find non-utf8 chars:
find STMicroelectronics -type f | xargs grep -anxv '.*'

Comments:

ST Internal Reference: 160255

[corrigami - 2023-10-20T13:41:12Z]

With regards,
